_doc: Allowlist for yarn audit high/critical advisories. Every entry needs a reason and a review date. See SUPPLY-CHAIN-SECURITY.md §5.

_fields.ghsa: GitHub Security Advisory ID — for humans
_fields.reason: why the advisory is allowlisted — REQUIRED
_fields.review: YYYY-MM-DD — REQUIRED, expired prints warning but does not fail

entries.reason: Build-time only via @graphprotocol/graph-cli. Path traversal on archive extraction; graph-cli extracts vendor-published npm tarballs, not untrusted input. No upstream fix (fix in <0.0.0), no released graph-cli drops decompress. Revisit if graph-cli publishes a version without decompress or if a fixed decompress ships. Re-reviewed 2026-10-22: still no fix and graph-cli 0.98.1 (latest) still depends on decompress ^4.2.1; only `graph node` uses it.

Symlink-chain bypass of 1122670, same package and path (@graphprotocol/graph-cli>decompress). graph-cli 0.98.1 only calls decompress in `graph node` (command-helpers/local-node.js) to unzip a graph-node release downloaded from GitHub; codegen/build/test/deploy never extract archives. No upstream fix (fix in <0.0.0) and latest graph-cli 0.98.1 still depends on decompress ^4.2.1. Revisit with 1122670.

Stack-exhaustion DoS on deeply nested brace patterns. Build-time only via @graphprotocol/graph-cli>kubo-rpc-client>it-glob>fast-glob>micromatch>braces; patterns come from our own code/config, not untrusted input, and graph-cli does not call kubo-rpc-client's globSource. No fixed braces release (fix in <0.0.0; 3.0.3 is latest). Revisit when braces ships a fix.
